card.ch3.label: Chapter 3
card.ch3.title: How to Build Something That Doesn't Exist
end.ch3.title: End of Chapter 3
end.ch3.body:
The Hero exists. His head is on backwards, his legs are in pencil and his vocabulary is one word long.
In Chapter 4 something that should have stayed shut gets opened.
tools.label: Typographic arrows:
page.p9.title: Assembly instructions: the ladder
page.p9.intro: Cut out the pieces and fit them to the workshop wall, from the bottom up, in the order shown.
page.p9.l4note: Piece 4: identical to piece 2. Not included.
page.p10.title: Typographic arrows
page.p10.intro: To correct a badly printed illustration, drag the right typographic arrow onto it. The arrows are at the bottom of every page.
page.p10.note: The arrows only work on the manual's illustrations. The world, luckily, stays as it is.
page.p10.margin: what if the world ended up in the manual?
page.p11.title: Cuttings and notes
page.p11.intro: Space reserved for the player's cuttings.
page.p11.margin: there are crumbs between the pages
page.p12.title: Character sheet: the Hero
page.p12.intro: Assemble the Hero as shown. Head and body can be found in the workshop. Legs are included (see dotted lines).
page.p12.hero: Fig. 12 — The Hero, assembled (more or less)
page.p12.margin: a dotted line is not a leg
n.w1: Welcome to the Assembly Workshop. This is where we build the Hero.
n.w2: Didn't I mention it? This game needs a Hero. So far the Hero has been you, but that was a temporary arrangement.
n.w3: The instructions are on page 12. Look.
n.w4: Head, body, legs. Simple assembly. Even for you.
n.w5: And no tricks this time: the manual stays in the manual and the world stays in the world. Clear?
n.empty1: An empty workshop. Full of things, but empty of Heroes.
n.empty3: The wall has holes for tools. The tools don't.
n.dropwrong1: And what exactly is that supposed to do?
n.ww1: Not on this page. The Hero's parts go on page 12, cuttings on page 11.
n.ww2: The manual doesn't know where to put it. Neither do I.
n.sheet_wrong: That's not a body part. Not even for a Hero.
n.tool1: That arrow won't help. Not everything needs rotating, resizing or duplicating. Almost everything, but not everything.
n.tool3: The arrows aren't decorations. They aren't magic wands either.
n.typo_poster: "Prats". Small prats, apparently. I won't comment.
n.typo_done: Yes, yes, you already found that one. Stop rubbing it in.
n.machine1: The Parts Dispenser. The Hero's body is inside. It runs on apples.
n.machine2: Don't kick the dispenser. It's the only one we have.
n.slot: An apple slot. It's small. Very small. Bonsai apples, probably.
n.tray_body: The Hero's body. Take it to the Character sheet, page 12.
n.tray_empty: The tray is empty. The dispenser is waiting for its apple.
n.apple2: The dispenser runs on apples. The sign says so. Signs don't lie. Hardly ever.
n.head_high1: The Hero's head, on the top shelf. Too high up.
n.head_high2: You'd need a ladder to reach it. Page 9. I only mention it because it's written down.
n.head_reach: Now you can reach it. Handle it gently: it's the Hero's head.
n.ladder_empty: The ladder goes here. Instructions on page 9. In order. From the bottom.
n.ladder_done: A ladder built by following the instructions. Almost moving.
n.platform: The test platform. This is where the Hero takes his first steps. Once there is a Hero.
n.piece4: Two piece 2s. We'll call one of them 4. The printer will never notice.
n.piece4_again: One piece 4 is enough. We're not building a skyscraper.
n.p3_fixed: Piece 3, finally the right way up. Hook on top, as the gods of manuals intended.
n.p3_undo: And now you've turned it upside down again. Why?
n.l_have: Piece 1 is already there. One is enough.
n.l_order: Just a moment. The pieces go in order: 1, 2, 3, 4. Numbers exist for a reason.
n.l1: Piece 1 fitted. You're a quarter of a ladder in.
n.l2_wait: Wait! Piece 4 is "identical to piece 2". If you fit 2 now, what will you copy it from?
n.l2: Piece 2 fitted. Half a ladder. Half a Hero? No, that comes later.
n.l3_flip: Piece 3 is printed upside down: the hook is at the bottom! The ladder will come apart.
n.l3: Piece 3, the right way up. The printer thanks you. Actually no, the printer knows nothing.
n.l4b: A ladder built with a photocopied piece. If it falls, blame the photocopy.
n.apple_in1: You put an APPLE in the manual?!
n.apple_in2: Things from the world do not go in the manual! Now there'll be crumbs between the pages. Forever.
n.apple_shrink: Resized. It said "resize", not "enlarge". Technically you're right. I hate it when you're right.
n.apple_grow: Big again. Make up your mind.
n.apple_dup: Two apples? The dispenser wants one. And photocopied apples taste of toner.
n.apple_rot: An upside-down apple. Exactly like before. Well done.
n.apple_big: Too big for the slot. The apple, I mean. The slot is perfect as it is.
n.dispense1: The dispenser accepted a miniature apple. It asked no questions.
n.dispense2: And here's the Hero's body. One size fits all.
n.sheet_head: The head on the sheet. It looks a little sleepy.
n.sheet_torso: The body on the sheet. Cape included. Little star included.
n.sheet_more: One piece still missing. Check the sheet on page 12.
p.legs1: the legs are missing. they're only dotted lines. i'll handle it.
p.legs2: done. that's two favours you owe me now.
n.legs: PENCIL legs?! They rub out with anything!
n.hero_ready: Fine. The Hero is ready. Take him to the test platform.
n.alive2: Um. The head is on backwards.
n.alive3: All he says is "Options". I've built a Hero who talks like a menu.
n.alive4: NO, no options! Options are in the pause menu!
p.end: he's perfect as he is. we'll need someone who looks backwards.
h.ladder.1: The ladder follows the instructions on page 9: one piece at a time, from the bottom, on the wall under the shelf.
h.ladder.2: Piece 3 is printed upside down and 4 is "not included". There are some arrows at the bottom of the manual...
h.ladder.3: Drag ↻ onto piece 3 and ×2 onto piece 2 (piece 4 appears). Then take pieces 1, 2, 3 and 4 to the wall under the shelf.
h.apple.1: The dispenser runs on apples and there's an apple on the table. But the slot is tiny.
h.apple.2: The arrows only work on the manual's illustrations. What if the apple became an illustration?
h.apple.3: Drag the apple from the table into the manual, on page 11. Shrink it with ⤢ and drag it onto the slot.
h.hero.1: The Character sheet is on page 12: you need a head and a body.
h.hero.2: The head is on the shelf, the body inside the dispenser. Things from the world can be dragged into the manual.
h.hero.3: Drag the head and the body onto page 12 of the manual, then take the Hero to the test platform.
h.none: No ideas right now. Odd: I usually have too many.
